summary: Pre-alpha: engine status, health and control of the running tray app, opt-in sign-in start, and the rule store (CRUD, validation, drafts, history, live reload); runs engine-control rules only

commands.name: capabilities
commands.summary: This document

commands.name: status
commands.summary: Engine state, rules summary, shortcuts, recent activity (rule IDs and outcome codes only) and sign-in start; works without the app

commands.name: health
commands.summary: On-demand check of the running app: identity, hook thread, callback timing, dropped signals, wake-ups and CPU time

commands.name: engine.start
commands.summary: Turn the engine on in the running app (never starts the app)

commands.name: engine.pause
commands.summary: Pause all rules except engine-control rules; held keys are released

commands.name: engine.resume
commands.summary: Resume a paused engine (never turns it on)

commands.name: engine.stop
commands.summary: Turn the engine off: remove the hook, release held keys, cancel runs

commands.name: quit
commands.summary: End the running tray app (the engine is turned off first)

commands.name: startup.status
commands.summary: Whether the tray app starts at sign-in (HKCU Run value)

commands.name: startup.enable
commands.summary: Opt in: start the tray app (engine off unless engine_on_start is on) when you sign in

commands.name: startup.disable
commands.summary: Stop starting the tray app at sign-in

commands.name: rule.list
commands.summary: Every rule with its trigger, state (active, disabled, inactive with a code, other mode or profile) and problem count; works without the app

commands.name: rule.show
commands.summary: One rule as stored, with its state and problems

commands.name: rule.check
commands.summary: Validate rules.json (schema and DDALGAK_RULE_MODEL §8) and list problems with non-destructive offers

commands.name: rule.add
commands.summary: Add a rule with a new ID; refused with nothing written when it would add an error; saved disabled without the consent it needs

commands.name: rule.edit
commands.summary: Change a rule's fields (its ID never changes)

commands.name: rule.delete
commands.summary: Remove rules (asks, or needs --yes)

commands.name: rule.duplicate
commands.summary: Copy a rule, disabled, with a new ID

commands.name: rule.enable
commands.summary: Switch rules on (consent is checked)

commands.name: rule.disable
commands.summary: Switch rules off; they are kept

commands.name: rule.move
commands.summary: Change a rule's place in its profile (the last precedence step)

commands.name: rule.revoke
commands.summary: Withdraw a consent; the rule is disabled and kept

commands.name: rules.history
commands.summary: The backup and the last 50 snapshots of applied changes

commands.name: rules.backup
commands.summary: Keep a snapshot of the saved rules now

commands.name: rules.restore
commands.summary: Bring back rules.json.bak or a snapshot as a new revision (asks, or needs --yes); an unusable file is kept

commands.name: rules.reload
commands.summary: Ask the running app to apply rules.json now; an invalid file keeps the active rules (never starts the app)

commands.name: rules.draft
commands.summary: The unsaved draft: its base revision and changes

commands.name: rules.draft.apply
commands.summary: Save the draft as the next revision (refused when the saved rules changed since)

commands.name: rules.draft.discard
commands.summary: Throw the draft away (asks, or needs --yes)
